english.note: This is the all-purpose exclamation of pleasure or approval, especially after something good happens.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese exclamation for celebrating good news or success.

examples.jyutping: kau4 deoi6 jap6 bo1 laa3 hou2 je5

examples.traditional: 我終於搵到份工喇，好嘢！
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 wan2 dou2 fan6 gung1 laa3 hou2 je5
